import ctypes, json
k = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
k.VirtualAlloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]
k.VirtualAlloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
k.VirtualFree.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_ulong]
k.VirtualFree.restype = ctypes.c_int
import subprocess, sys
amount = 314572800
p = k.VirtualAlloc(None, amount, 0x3000, 0x04)
print(json.dumps({"parent_requested_commit_bytes": amount, "parent_allocation_succeeded": bool(p)}), flush=True)
if not p:
    raise SystemExit(4)
try:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", 'import ctypes, json\nk = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)\nk.VirtualAlloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]\nk.VirtualAlloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p\nk.VirtualFree.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_ulong]\nk.VirtualFree.restype = ctypes.c_int\namount = 268435456\np = k.VirtualAlloc(None, amount, 0x3000, 0x04)\nerror = ctypes.get_last_error() if not p else 0\nprint(json.dumps({"requested_commit_bytes": amount, "allocation_succeeded": bool(p), "winerror": error}), flush=True)\nreleased = not p or bool(k.VirtualFree(p, 0, 0x8000))\nexpected = bool(p) if False else not p and error != 0\nraise SystemExit(0 if expected and released else 3)\n'],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, creationflags=0x08000000)
    print(json.dumps({"child_exit": result.returncode, "child_stdout": result.stdout, "child_stderr": result.stderr}), flush=True)
finally:
    released = bool(k.VirtualFree(p, 0, 0x8000))
raise SystemExit(0 if result.returncode == 0 and released else 5)
